description: Cs₅Na(W₂N₅)₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁ space group. There are three inequivalent Cs sites. In the first Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six N atoms. There are a spread of Cs-N bond distances ranging from 3.23-3.69 Å. In the second Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of Cs-N bond distances ranging from 3.24-3.57 Å. In the third Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight N atoms. There are a spread of Cs-N bond distances ranging from 3.48-3.74 Å. Na is bonded to four N atoms to form distorted NaN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four WN₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.32 Å) and two longer (2.34 Å) Na-N bond lengths. There are two inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to four N atoms to form WN₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaN₄ tetrahedra and corners with three WN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of W-N bond distances ranging from 1.79-1.93 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded to four N atoms to form WN₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaN₄ tetrahedra and corners with three WN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of W-N bond distances ranging from 1.79-1.92 Å. There are five inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to three Cs, one Na, and one W atom. In the second N site, N is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Cs, one Na, and one W atom. In the third N site, N is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to three Cs and two equivalent W atoms. In the fourth N site, N is bonded in a linear geometry to two Cs and two equivalent W atoms. In the fifth N site, N is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two Cs and two W atoms.
